decision: Bind an already verified final-pair BoundaryShift to the exact observed Space presentation through its existing pending client-commit receipt.
reason: The rich native receipt exposes an ASCII-only pair scope. Firefox represents the first owned Space as NBSP and can change that internal boundary back to ASCII while presenting the second committed Space as NBSP. Core Apply is present, but no editable pair is admitted. A parser-only change cannot prove the subsequent raw edit or its inverse.

consequences.authority: Keep the same core winner, sealed transition, pending Space receipt, exact field snapshot, owner/focus/epoch/material identity, lifetime and one-shot executor. Only two already owned separator positions may have ASCII/NBSP presentation. Every letter, external prefix/suffix, cursor, anchor and all other positions must remain exact. No generic normalization or reconstruction from suffix equality.
consequences.safety: Preserve the existing SafetyGate, surface-preserving BoundaryShift test and exact dry-run. Source and selected target use the same bounded ASCII/NBSP pair parser; the original core strings and receipt are verified without initial resealing. Only the actual client commit can rebind the two already owned separator positions, after whole-field and same-authority validation. Rebinding preserves both words and is rejected for any other character or scope change. No manually weighted lexical exception.
consequences.undo: Record the rebound sealed physical forward action. Its inverse restores the actual full raw source, including the observed final separator. An equal later snapshot cannot resurrect a refused or expired continuation.
consequences.delivery: Use the existing ordinary preedit Space commit, its client acknowledgement and the existing committed-tail replacement. No new route, owner, queue, fallback, RPC, timer or deadline. Atomic and native-observed transports retain their existing scope checks.
consequences.cost: Two bounded pair parses and one bounded full-snapshot comparison at the existing continuation; no model, ranker, training or persistent-data changes. Timing remains a changed-byte native gate.
consequences.rollback: Revert this bounded presentation change and its tests/decision together, preserving preceding auxiliary-hint fixes and immutable negative native receipts. No local installation or data migration.
